### What is the Smart Steward Method™? The **Smart Steward Method™** is a fundraising framework created by **DonorDock** to help nonprofits build and maintain lasting donor relationships through effective stewardship. It emphasizes **iteration** (a continuous "Relationship Loop") rather than one-off efforts, allowing teams to scale without large staff or complex tech. It's designed for time-strapped teams, focusing on personalization, automation, and data-driven engagement to boost retention, average gifts, and re-engagement of lapsed donors. Key principle: Donor stewardship is a **loop**, not a line—repeating and refining processes keeps relationships strong as donor expectations evolve. #### The Three E's: Core Steps The method revolves around **Evaluate, Establish, Execute**, forming a repeatable cycle: | Step | Description | Key Actions | |------------|-------------|-------------| | **Evaluate** | Audit data quality, identify donor drop-off points, and assess gaps (e.g., integrations, journey hurdles). Make this ongoing: "What do we have? What have we learned? What has changed?" | - Check data quality
- Spot lapses or integration issues
- Use tools like DonorDock's free Smart Steward Assessment for a snapshot. | | **Establish** | Set metrics, map donor journeys, automate tasks, and document processes. | - Define success (e.g., retention rates)
- Build 3-4 core journeys (e.g., new donor welcome, recurring gratitude, major donor touches, lapsed re-engagement)
- Prioritize high-impact tasks. | | **Execute** | Implement with automation handling routine work, freeing staff for personal interactions. Iterate back to Evaluate. | - Run automated thank-yous, nudges, and journeys
- Track interactions in CRM
- Refine based on engagement data. | #### Implementation with DonorDock - **Standalone use**: Fully possible without DonorDock—focus on the framework manually. - **With DonorDock + Otto (AI assistant)**: Automates heavily: - **6 pre-built journeys** for scenarios like birthdays, lapses, or re-engagement. - **Smart Nudges**: Surfaces timely tasks (e.g., "Call this donor now"). - **AI features**: Generates personalized thank-yous, subject lines, and impact language; pulls gift data automatically. - **Touchpoint tracking**: Full donor history preserved, no "plans in someone's head." - Benefits: Instant thank-yous post-gift, segmented comms, capacity for lean teams (e.g., block time for "stewardship sprints" guided by CRM). #### Evidence of Impact - From DonorDock case studies: Shifts from ad-hoc (delayed thanks, lost records) to systematic (minutes-to-thank-you, 100% tracked interactions). - Targets small/growing nonprofits: Handles events, grants, etc., without burnout. - Free resources: [Smart Steward Assessment](https://www.donordock.com/tools/smart-steward-assessment) for gaps; articles on [AI integration](https://www.donordock.com/articles/how-nonprofits-can-use-ai-for-donor-stewardship) and [personalization](https://www.donordock.com/articles/how-to-personalize-stewardship-without-a-huge-team). For full details, see [DonorDock's Smart Steward page](https://www.donordock.com/smart-steward-method) or [Relationship Loop article](https://www.donordock.com/articles/the-relationship-loop-a-nonprofit-stewardship-framework). This framework is practical, proven for nonprofits, and evolves with your org.
